propositions: When a writer has a configured signing_key but no resolvable author_id, _apply_authorship silently skips signing and returns with no log, hiding the authorship failure
fsck's authorship tally is computed store-wide without per-env breakdown, so a single environment writing 0% signed events remains invisible behind other environments' healthy signing volume
Dormant environments that pre-date the store's first signed event must not be false-positively reported as unsigned, even if they contain 0% signed events
_apply_authorship must emit a WARNING log when signing is skipped due to missing identity or missing signing_key, naming the event UUID and the ticket, while remaining best-effort (no write failure)

fsck must count and report any active environment with either zero signed events or every event authored Unknown/absent, but only if that environment wrote at or after the store's earliest signed event
The unsigned_env finding must appear as a counted issue in fsck output (issue_count and JSON issues[] array) with the env_id as the line head, not parsed as a ticket_id
